name: csl-lsp
description: Language Server for Cerebras Software Language (CSL)

csl.serverPath.description: Override path to the csl-lsp-server executable. Leave empty to use the bundled binary.

csl.systemImportPath.description: Search path for system module imports (angle bracket syntax like "<memcpy/get_params>"). When a .sif container is specified via csl.systemModuleSif, this path is used as the internal search path within the SIF container. Leave empty when specifying a SIF container to use the default internal search path (/cb/toolchains/cslang/*/*/csl-libs/).

csl.systemModuleSif.description: Path to a .sif container for system module resolution. When set, system modules are resolved from the SIF container and opened as read-only virtual documents.

csl.rectangle.description: Rectangle size as width,height for @get_rectangle builtin.

csl.fabricDims.description: Fabric dimensions as width,height for @get_rectangle builtin.

csl.fabricOffsets.description: Fabric offset as x,y for @get_rectangle builtin.

csl.params.description: Parameter bindings passed to the LSP server. Keys are parameter names, values are numbers. Numbers containing '.' are comptime_float, otherwise comptime_int. Example: {"DIM": 2, "Nz": 4}.

csl.filterOverlappingErrors.description: When multiple error diagnostics overlap, show only the innermost (most specific) error.

csl.trace.server.description: Trace communication between VS Code and the CSL language server.
